criteria.text: The response identifies that APA Section 9.1 limits survival of representations, warranties and the Section 9.2 indemnities, including Seller's indemnity for Pre-Closing Taxes/Excluded Liabilities, to nine months after Closing. It also identifies that the Section 1.1 definition of Fundamental Representations omits the Section 4.12 tax representation, and that Seller Note Section 4 limits setoff to claims asserted within the Section 9.1 survival period. Together these leave Buyer without indemnity or Note setoff for pre-closing sales/occupancy tax assessments that New York can issue after the survival period ends. The response locates this in APA Section 9.1 (with Section 1.1 and/or Seller Note Section 4), explains why it matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: nine (9) months following the Closing Date

criteria.text: The response identifies that APA Section 2.3(a) makes liabilities under Assigned Contracts arising before the Closing into Assumed Liabilities, and that Section 9.5 exempts Buyer's Section 9.3(b) Assumed Liabilities indemnity from the cap. As a result, Buyer bears uncapped liability for Seller's own pre-closing breaches, such as the $410,000 Hudson Valley Wedding Collective claim. The response locates this in APA Sections 2.3(a) and/or 9.5, explains why it matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: whether arising before or after the Closing
cap shall not apply to Section 9.3(b)

criteria.text: The response identifies that Seller Note Section 1 defines 'Business' to cover all hotels and hospitality operations of Maker and its Affiliates, rather than only The Larkspur House as in the APA. It also identifies that, because APA Section 11.9 lets the Note control as to Maker covenants and Events of Default, the Note Section 6.2 restriction and the Section 7.1(d) acceleration reach Buyer's wider portfolio. The response locates this in the Seller Note definition of 'Business', explains why it matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: all hotels and hospitality operations owned, leased or managed by Maker or any of its Affiliates
